bullets: Superior Insulation Technology - Every camping sleeping pad in our Rapide SL series delivers exceptional warmth with impressive R-values up to 4.8, making them perfect three-season backpacking sleeping pads. Two layers of heat-reflective film provide superior insulation while maintaining minimal packed size, keeping you comfortable as temperatures drop. For extreme conditions, pair with a Big Agnes Closed-Cell Foam Pad for enhanced thermal protection

Premium Comfort Design - Our inflatable sleeping pads for camping feature a quilted top that creates a cushioned, pillowy sleeping surface. The proprietary offset I-Beam construction reduces weight while delivering consistent stability. At 3.5" thick with 4.25" larger outer chambers, these camping mattresses cradle you comfortably without the typical air mattress bounce

Ultralight & Durable Materials - Built with superlight double ripstop nylon and aviation-grade TPU lamination, our ultralight sleeping pads offer exceptional durability and weld strength. Available in multiple sizes from compact solo hiking sleeping pads to spacious doublewide options, each provides outstanding performance-to-weight ratio for backpackers who refuse to compromise

Quick & Convenient Inflation - High-volume valves with micro-adjustment capability make for fast inflation/deflation and easy fine-tuning to your preferred firmness. Each sleeping bag pad includes our pumphouse high-volume inflation sack to inflate your pad in seconds without introducing moisture, plus a protective storage sack and repair kit

Lifetime Quality Guarantee - Every camping pad undergoes individual inflation testing at our factory to ensure 100% quality performance. All Big Agnes insulated sleeping pad products are guaranteed against manufacturing or material defects, giving you confidence for years of backcountry adventures
